$schemaComment: Public barrel values that need no Globals/Preview import: theme infrastructure, mount-once hosts, shell-only icons, and pure helpers with docs/live elsewhere. Keep in sync with scripts/check-wysiwyg.mjs.

notes.SnackbarHost: Mounted once in SandboxShell; snackbar() is demoed in Globals.
notes.formatDateValue/parseDateValue: DatePicker companion helpers; live echo beside DatePicker when useful.
notes.formatTimeValue/parseTimeValue: TimePicker companion helpers; demoed beside TimePicker in Globals.
notes.ICON_SIZE: Default glyph size constant for IconButton / inline icons.
notes.theme_*: TOKEN_GROUPS + *TOKENS + themeMode + scrollbar + gen helpers — Foundations/inspector surface.
notes.highlight_*: CodeBlock registry helpers; Wave 3 adds minimal live registerHighlightLanguage path.
notes.overflow_*: OVERFLOW_EPSILON + free functions; useOverflowBounds is demoed in Globals.
notes.busy_*: afterNextPaint / yieldToMain / runBusyTask — Wave 3 live; useBusyTask already demoed.
notes.shell_icons: Sun/Moon/Bot/Download/Mic/ArrowUp/StopSquare/ChevronDown used by SandboxShell chrome. App-chrome icons (AlertTriangle/Check/CheckCircle/Close/Globe/Plug) are public without dedicated Globals demos.
notes.ensureOverlayScrollbars: Auto-started from the barrel; token-skinned fixed portal thumbs for .fynns-scroll (native bars hidden).
